comment: The small knob sharing a centre with the offset knob is the global ring attenuator, and the small knob sharing a centre with the sample-and-hold rate is the slew amount; both are drawn as inner knobs on top of the larger one. Ten parameters have no widget: the eight that hold the output and modulation modes across a save, the negative-output menu flag, and an end-of-release flag that the maker never named in configParam.
